summary: The Colorado Association of School Executives (CASE) opposes any proposal to eliminate or limit the E-Rate program, emphasizing its importance for providing connectivity to students across Colorado. CASE represents approximately 3,300 public school administrators from nearly all of Colorado’s 187 school districts.
